templates.title: 青幻 · chill 说唱 / R&B
templates.prompt: A hip-hop track with a melancholic yet rhythmic feel, featuring a male vocalist, The instrumentation includes a prominent synth bass providing a deep, driving rhythm, a drum machine with a consistent kick and snare pattern, and a high-pitched synth melody that occasionally interjects, The vocal delivery is a blend of rapping and melodic phrases, often layered with harmonies, The song structure follows a typical verse-chorus format, with a clear distinction between the more narrative verses and the repetitive, hook-driven chorus, The tempo is moderate, creating a head-nodding groove, Production elements include reverb on the vocals and some subtle delay effects on the synth melodies, contributing to a spacious sound, The overall key appears to be minor, enhancing the somber mood of the lyrics, The mixing emphasizes the vocals and the synth bass, with the drums providing a solid foundation

templates.title: 男生 · 城市流行（BPM 85–95）
templates.prompt:
[Male vocal], [final vocal mix]
Urban Pop。
Bright male vocal, with a clean background of rhythmic synth chords and smooth electric piano. The intro gradually builds with punchy electronic drums and deep bass. The verse is accented by muted electric guitar riffs, while the chorus is layered with catchy vocal hooks and shimmering synth textures, forming a vibrant and modern sound. The outro fades with soft vocal harmonies and subtle instrumental echoes, emotions remain controlled and stylish.
Style: Urban Pop, Modern
Rhythm: Mid-tempo groove (BPM 85-95)
Instruments: Electric piano, synths, electric guitar, bass, electronic drums, vocal harmonies
Emotional keywords: hope / youth / sophistication
Vocal & Harmony: Mid-close male vocals, tight harmonies, rhythmic phrasing, occasional falsetto
Arrangement: Modern pop chord progressions, syncopated beats, spatial effects, layered synths, bass-driven movement, stereo imaging

templates.title: 男生 · 民谣（BPM 65–75）
templates.prompt:
[Male vocal], [final vocal mix]
Folk。
Deep male voice interpretation, with warm background laid by string and piano, the prelude gradually progresses with bass piano and soft percussion, the main song is embellished with acoustic guitar, and the chorus is layered with bass and string music, resulting in a thick and delicate overall tone, The ending note fades away and the emotions are restrained,
Style: Popular Lyrical
Rhythm: Medium Slow Board (BPM 65-75)
Instrument: Piano+String+Environmental Space Sense
Emotional keywords: regret/tenderness/sense of destiny
Mid distance vocals and multi-layered harmonic structures, with large string instruments promoting lyrical progression, close range wind instruments embellishing, Pads expanding spatial sense, harmony and arrangement developed based on the Carnon variant of leading bass, with the seventh note of the first major seventh chord being played by the cello, and long-distance stereo harmony

templates.title: 女生 · 华语流行抒情
templates.prompt:
[Female vocal], [final vocal mix]
Pop Ballad。
Warm and expressive female vocal, with a gentle background of piano and soft strings. The intro gradually unfolds with delicate piano arpeggios and subtle percussion. The verse is adorned with acoustic guitar and light harmonies, while the chorus is enriched by layered strings and emotional vocal stacks, creating a lush and heartfelt atmosphere. The ending note softly fades, leaving a sense of tenderness and restraint.
Style: Pop Ballad, Lyrical
Rhythm: Slow tempo (BPM 65-75)
Instruments: Piano, strings, acoustic guitar, bass, soft percussion, vocal harmonies
Emotional keywords: longing / warmth / hope
Vocal & Harmony: Close female vocals, gentle harmonies, emotional phrasing, smooth falsetto highlights
Arrangement: Flowing chord progressions, gradual build-up, rich reverb for space, strings supporting melodic development, bass guiding harmony, stereo layering

templates.title: 女生 · 国风 / Ethnic Fusion
templates.prompt:
[Female Vocal], [final vocal mix]
Ethnic Fusion.
Markante Dizi oder Synth-Flöte prägt das Stück mit Hauptmelodien, stark von chinesischer traditioneller Musik beeinflusst. Weiblicher Hauptgesang wird von mehrstimmigen Chören unterstützt. Atmosphärische Synthesizer-Pads und Streicher erweitern den Raum. Elektronische Perkussion und Synthesizer-Bass legen das rhythmische Fundament. Gesamtstimmung: meditativ, spirituell, mit Weltmusik-Charakter.
Style: Ethnic Fusion, World Music
Rhythm: Slow to Medium
Instrument: Dizi/Synth-Flöte, Gesang, Synthesizer, Perkussion
Emotional keywords: Meditativ, Spirituell, Traditionell, Atmosphärisch, Kulturell
Key Features: Prominente Dizi-Melodien, Gesang auf Mandarin, Fusion chinesischer Elemente mit elektronischen Klanglandschaften.

structure_tags.explain: 通常节奏性强且克制，相比副歌部分旋律性和能量感较弱。
通常是歌曲的副歌，重复出现时会让歌曲感觉更有意图和情感。
用于主要模式之外的零散歌词。在歌曲过渡时制造悬念，通常不押韵或看起来不适合韵律。

lyrics_rules: 禁止：物品罗列、反问、「是不是」、随意符号堆砌
增强：情绪主线贯穿；浅显金句；多结构押韵/谐音
公式：氛围营造 → 情感倾诉 → 意象深化 → 情感总结
歌词用 [Verse]/[Chorus]/[Bridge] 等结构标签；短句留白，跟着腔唱，忌念词腔
格式末尾可加编曲/人声效果提示
